releaseName: Requirements extraction on the writing model's consent
summary: A job's requirements are extracted with the consent a record gives its writing model alone, since extraction calls only that model; before, a record without consent for the critic's company got no requirements and no error (#2857). A revision patch from an automatic round now applies, and the run trace says why a patch fell back (#2855). The previous release added the Send feedback button, the migration compatibility check and production sign-in (#2828, #2831).
knownLimitations: The operator reads feedback notes through the API only; there is no operator screen yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs.
